hypotheses.justification: The same proof works without this instance. opFamily requires only CommRing 𝒪 and NeZero N; diamondL_top_eq_one has the same requirements, and heckeT_comm_of_prime works with arbitrary additive commutative coefficients. No cancellation or absence of zero divisors is used.

The same proof works in positive characteristic: opFamily and diamondL_top_eq_one require only CommRing 𝒪 and NeZero N, while heckeT_comm_of_prime requires only additive commutative coefficients. The primality and coprimality arguments concern natural-number indices, not their images in 𝒪.

Neither the statement's definitions nor the proof's lemmas require locality. The same proof works for any commutative coefficient ring. All three reported instances can also be omitted simultaneously; even the zero ring is harmless, since its coefficient homomorphisms and endomorphisms are unique.
